note: Synthetic Sentinel-1/2 scenes with known ground truth (satquery/demo/synth.py).

scenarios.title: Single Sentinel-2 scene (12 bands)
queries: Describe the land-cover and major objects visible in this image.
Highlight the water body referred to in the query.
Is there more vegetation than built-up area?
How many water bodies are there?

scenarios.title: Single Sentinel-1 SAR scene (VV/VH)
queries: Is there any water in this image?

scenarios.title: Cross-modal: cloudy Sentinel-2 + Sentinel-1
queries: Use the optical and SAR images together to identify built-up and water-covered regions.
How much of the scene is water?
Describe the scene using both sensors.

scenarios.title: Bi-temporal Sentinel-2 (2024 → 2025)
queries: What changed between these two dates, and where did the change occur?
Has the built-up area increased, decreased, or remained unchanged?
What did the water turn into?
How much of the area changed?

scenarios.title: Bi-temporal Sentinel-1 (2024 → 2025)
queries: What changed between these two dates, and where did the change occur?
